content:
**Governance table cells stay in table layout (#1310)**

Decisions and Anti-patterns tables shifted a column because classes applied to <td> (.decision-status, .decision-title, .anti-pattern-scope, .anti-pattern-title; also .memory-actor with display:flex in the Memory view) set a non-table display. Fix: chip classes moved to inner span/div, cells get *-cell classes; static/table-cells.test.mjs scans app.css for display on any class applied to td/th/tr. Rule: never style a table cell with display; put chips on an inner element.
